Writtle University College is a leading provider of land-based, animal, environmental, design and sport education in the UK.

We are set on a stunning countryside estate with landscaped gardens, animal units, a working farm, sports facilities, research laboratories and design studios, in addition to many other specialist teaching facilities. Located in rural Essex, we are perfectly situated just two miles from the city of Chelmsford. 

Our lecturers work closely with industry to create courses that are relevant to today’s world and meet the modern demands of a fast-paced and changing environment. Our students are more than just a number to us and we take great pride in providing an academic experience that allows our students to flourish and achieve their career ambitions.
